message: No detected input validation: The code reads images and directories without validating file types, image dimensions, dtypes, or value ranges before processing them.
No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local filesystem paths with no remote fetching, checksum verification, or source authentication present.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation code performs only image processing operations (binarization, skeletonization, segmentation) with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs against poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: Models are loaded via hardcoded file paths using torch.load without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; no integrity verification is performed before loading the checkpoint.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distribution before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism is imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation, hashed/signed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads images from disk and passes them directly through the pipeline without any shape, range, or format validation before feeding them to the models.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model output probabilities, NaN guards, or confidence thresholds visible in the inference data-flow path.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer-vision pipeline (Hebrew character recognition/style classification), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
